content:
Short answer: many — dozens to a few hundred.  

More detail:
- I was trained on multilingual text, so I can read and understand (and translate or respond in) a large number of languages and writing systems. I’m strongest in English and other high‑resource languages such as Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Bengali, Urdu, Turkish, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian/Malay, Persian, and most major European languages.
- I also handle many other languages and scripts (Latin, Cyrillic, Arabic, Devanagari, Han characters, Hangul, Kana, Thai, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Burmese, Georgian, Armenian, etc.), though accuracy drops for low‑resource or rare languages, small dialects, or heavily nonstandard orthography.
- Limitations: performance varies by language and task (translation, nuance, idioms). I don’t directly process audio unless it’s transcribed, and OCR/handwriting in images can be imperfect. For very obscure languages, endangered languages, or specialized technical jargon, I may be less reliable.

If you want, paste a sample in a particular language and I’ll show you how well I can read and work with it.
